Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software și Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Cognizant Romania is home to 2300+ creative technologists and is one of Eastern Europe's largest Software Product Engineering delivery networks. We serve global clients in several industries, including Banking & Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Communication Media & Technology, and Retail & MLEU (manufacturing, logistics, energy & utilities).
 Cognizant Romania was established in 2018 when Cognizant acquired Softvision, a company founded in the late 1990s in Cluj-Napoca, Romania. We continue to build on our history as the preferred engineering partner for thriving Silicon Valley tech companies, now as a prominent Cognizant next generation studio.
 This role requires on-site type of work, 5 days/week, in Floreasca area - Bucharest. 
 About the role 
 We are looking for a hands-on Field Service Engineer to provide onsite technical support across customer locations.
 In this role, you will troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, workplace technology, connectivity and audio-visual issues. You will work closely with the Service Desk, infrastructure teams, external vendors and client support organisations to ensure incidents and service requests are handled efficiently.
 The position combines desk support, smart hands activities, equipment deployment and maintenance, meeting-room technology support and end-user assistance.
 Key responsibilities 
 Onsite and helpdesk support: 
Provide onsite technical support for workplace technology, equipment and end-user devices.
Diagnose and resolve hardware, operating system, software, peripheral and network-access issues.
Perform deskside support for laptops, desktops and other user equipment.
Support device setup, configuration, provisioning and post-deployment validation.
Perform moves, additions, changes and decommissions of end-user and infrastructure equipment.
Replace or hot-swap devices that cannot be repaired onsite.
Coordinate warranty replacement for defective equipment.
Test repaired or replacement devices to confirm that they operate correctly and contain the required end-user image.
Restore the user’s work area to its original condition after completing support activities.
Obtain user acknowledgement following the completion of service requests.
 Device configuration and maintenance 
Configure BIOS, hardware settings, operating system settings and system drivers when required.
Install and configure applications included in the core image, as well as approved layered applications.
Ensure that encryption, authentication, VPN and access-management software is configured in line with client policies and procedures.
Validate and configure network connectivity settings.
Deploy device software patches and hardware upgrades in line with corporate compliance requirements.
Assist users with data backups and the recovery of lost or damaged files from available local-drive backups.
Decommission end-user equipment from the relevant asset-management systems when devices are removed from the client environment.
 Infrastructure and smart hands support 
Perform onsite smart hands activities, including hardware installation and testing, server and storage reboots, power cycles and post-maintenance validation.
Collaborate with infrastructure and network support providers to resolve onsite network and compute issues.
Support customer-location surveys, including rack elevations and equipment inventories.
Escort third-party engineers and break-fix vendors to designated equipment locations when required.
Coordinate with external providers during onsite installation, maintenance and repair activities.
 Audio-visual and meeting-room support 
Provide onsite smart hands support for audio-visual and video-conferencing environments.
Validate that conferencing systems, telepresence solutions, video-conferencing suites, endpoints and meeting-room panels are operational.
Support meeting-room setup, troubleshooting and break-fix activities.
Coordinate third-party audio-visual equipment installation projects.
Support live events when requested by the customer.
Check network printers and multifunction devices for errors and support the resolution process.
 Service management and user support 
Coordinate with the Service Desk, client support teams and third parties to deliver technical support services.
Manage incidents and service requests in accordance with established processes.
Ensure tickets contain sufficient information, including the issue description, actions taken and resolution details.
Contact the requester when additional information is required and escalate to the Team Leader or Manager when guidance is needed.
Provide users with clear instructions and practical assistance for devices and software.
Support new employee onboarding and other scheduled onsite appointments.
Provide Level 2 support and coordinate with third-party mobile data and voice carriers when required.
Deliver enhanced onsite support to authorised VIP users, including walk-up support where applicable.
Ensure that a ticket is logged and the required approval is obtained before addressing unplanned walk-up requests.
 Required skills and experience 
Previous experience in a IT Desktop Support or similar onsite IT support role.
Hands-on experience troubleshooting laptops, desktops, peripherals and other end-user devices.
Good knowledge of Windows operating systems, system drivers, BIOS and hardware configuration.
Experience supporting Microsoft Office and other standard workplace applications.
Understanding of network connectivity, VPN, authentication, encryption and access-management solutions.
Experience with device provisioning, software deployment, patching and hardware upgrades.
Familiarity with incident, service request and ticket-management processes.
Experience supporting audio-visual equipment, meeting rooms and video-conferencing systems.
Ability to perform basic smart hands activities for network, server and storage equipment.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
Clear communication and customer-service skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively with Service Desk teams, infrastructure specialists, external vendors and business users.
A structured approach to documentation, escalation and follow-up.
Ability to provide professional onsite support and explain technical solutions clearly to end users.
 Cognizant Romania Employee Benefits: 
 Flexible Work Schedule – Outside of core working hours, you have the flexibility to arrange your schedule in a way that best suits your personal and professional needs.
 Annual Leave – Enjoy 26 vacation days each year to relax, recharge, travel, and spend quality time with family and friends.
 Learning & Development – Access a wide range of training programs, workshops, certifications, and continuous learning opportunities to support your professional growth.
 Private Medical Insurance – Comprehensive healthcare coverage for your wellbeing and peace of mind.
 Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential professional support services to help you navigate personal, emotional, financial, legal, or work-related challenges.
 Meal Tickets – Monthly meal allowance provided through meal vouchers.
 Referral Bonus Program – Help us grow our team and be rewarded for successful referrals.
 Life Insurance – Additional protection and financial security
 Banking Benefits – Preferential banking services and financial products through our partner institutions.
 Bookster Library – Access thousands of books, audiobooks, and learning resources to support both personal and professional development.
 Please note that only suitable candidates will be contacted. Cognizant and its affiliated companies are firmly committed to protecting your privacy.
